description: Update an existing Security Case Task in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_security_case_task afterwards to see the updated record.

assignedToUserId.description: ID of the person doing the task. Empty while nobody is.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Security Case Task to update. Required. Use list_security_case_tasks to find IDs.

isDone.description: Whether the task is done. Setting it records who did it and when; clearing it opens the task again.

title.description: What has to be done, in a line.
title.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

name: update_security_case_task
title: Update Security Case Task
